description: Nova's failure pattern library - learned from 50+ eval runs

patterns.name: File Not Created
patterns.symptom: verify_file check fails: file not found
patterns.root_cause: LLM describes what to do instead of actually writing the file. Tool call was text, not a real Write call.
patterns.detection: If verify_file exists in task and file doesn't exist after run
patterns.fix_strategy: Remind model to USE tools, not describe them. Inject _TOOL_USE_REMINDER.

patterns.name: Test Assertion Mismatch
patterns.symptom: test failed: assertion error or unexpected output
patterns.root_cause: Model writes tests that don't match the expected behavior, or misreads the spec.
patterns.detection: verify_test fails with AssertionError or wrong output
patterns.fix_strategy: Read the spec carefully. Run the target code first to understand behavior.

patterns.name: Import Error
patterns.root_cause: Wrong module name in import, or missing __init__.py
patterns.fix_strategy: Check actual file names vs import statements. Ensure __init__.py exists.

patterns.name: Context Overflow Loop
patterns.symptom: Task runs out of iterations or tokens without completing
patterns.root_cause: Accumulated tool results fill context window. Model keeps re-reading same files.
patterns.detection: Token budget exceeded or max_iterations reached
patterns.fix_strategy: Smart message trimming at 80% threshold. Preserve recent rounds only.

patterns.name: Read Loop Stuck
patterns.symptom: Model reads the same file multiple times without making changes
patterns.root_cause: Model loses track of what it already read. Context window pushes out earlier reads.
patterns.detection: Multiple consecutive Read calls on same path
patterns.fix_strategy: Detect duplicate reads in decision engine. Skip if already in recent context.

patterns.name: Wrong Fix Applied
patterns.symptom: Model modifies the file but the bug isn't fixed or a new bug is introduced
patterns.root_cause: Model misunderstands the bug. Applies superficial fix without running tests.
patterns.fix_strategy: Always run the test after fixing. If still failing, re-read the error message.

patterns.name: Output Capture Failure
patterns.symptom: Expected output not found in file or stdout
patterns.root_cause: Model runs command but doesn't redirect output to file, or captures stderr instead of stdout.
patterns.detection: verify_file exists but doesn't contain expected text
patterns.fix_strategy: Explicitly redirect stdout to file. Use subprocess capture_output.

patterns.name: Config Not Read
patterns.symptom: Output shows hardcoded values instead of config values
patterns.root_cause: Model modifies main.py but doesn't actually add json.load() call
patterns.detection: verify_output_contains fails - shows old hardcoded value
patterns.fix_strategy: Read config.json first, then modify main.py to load it.

patterns.name: Test Discovery Failure
patterns.symptom: pytest finds 0 tests or runs wrong tests
patterns.root_cause: Test function names don't follow pytest conventions, or wrong file path.
patterns.fix_strategy: Ensure test functions start with 'test_'. Use correct file path.

patterns.name: Windows Path Issues
patterns.symptom: File not found or permission error on Windows
patterns.root_cause: Forward/backslash confusion, or encoding issues with Chinese paths.
patterns.fix_strategy: Use os.path.join() or pathlib. Use encoding='utf-8' for open().

anti_patterns.name: Describe Instead of Do
anti_patterns.description: Model writes 'I will create a file...' instead of calling Write tool
anti_patterns.trigger: When model is uncertain about the task
anti_patterns.prevention: System prompt: 'Do not describe. Use tools directly.'

anti_patterns.name: Read-Read-Read Loop
anti_patterns.description: Model reads the same file 3+ times without editing
anti_patterns.trigger: When context window pushes out earlier read results
anti_patterns.prevention: Smart trimming preserves recent tool results. Detect duplicate reads.

anti_patterns.name: Ignore Test Output
anti_patterns.description: Model runs test, sees failure, but applies wrong fix
anti_patterns.trigger: When error message is long or complex
anti_patterns.prevention: Extract key error line from test output and highlight it.
